title: Finishing Through Contact
description: Attack the basket against a defender using body control, a strong two-foot finish and the off-hand shoulder to protect the ball against light contact.

content.objective: Finish at the rim after contact by staying balanced, protecting the ball with the body and going up strong with two hands.
content.setup: Attackers in a line at the wing with a ball each. A defender stands one step inside the three-point line with hands up and gives light contact only.
instructions: The attacker takes two hard dribbles toward the basket, attacking the defender's outside shoulder.
The defender gives light contact with a forearm on the attacker's body; no reaching or pushing.
The attacker stays balanced, lowers the shoulder, protects the ball on the far side and jumps off two feet.
Finish off the backboard or straight up; the attacker keeps the ball high through contact.
Rotate: attacker to the defender's spot, defender to the back of the line.
coachingPoints: Two hard dribbles, then a strong last step: get low, then go up.
Ball on the far side from the defender, both hands on the ball.
Finish through the contact; do not float away from it.
Land balanced and ready to rebound.
commonMistakes: Fading away from contact instead of finishing.
Carrying the ball low where the defender can strip it.
One-foot takeoff with the ball on the wrong side.
content.safety: Defenders may only give light contact with the forearm; no charging, hitting the arms or pushing. Use a coach's whistle to stop unsafe play.
progressions: Add a second defender helping from the weak side.
regressions: Defender holds a pad or stands with arms folded and provides only body pressure.
variations: Finish after a jump stop instead of a stride stop.
